title: R4-B1T pre-registration: boundary-representation feasibility audit (no training). Committed before any Gate 1-5 run.
scope: 10 frozen training sheets only (freeze_config.json data_roles.train) for Gates 1-3; labels, GeoTIFF RGB and the R4-A2 Q3 log only; no model output, no validation-sheet data, no training
change_policy: Each gate runs once. After this commit only crash / implementation-bug fixes, documented with reason; no change of sigma, thresholds, rules, sheet order. Results that miss a criterion are recorded, not re-run.
width: experiments/R4B1T/r4b1t_width.canonical_widths (Gate 0); bins 3-6 / 6-10 / 10-20 px, lt3 and ge20 as extra rows
key_fact: M2_hybrid regions use only the distance head (watershed on -dist, hybrid markers); the boundary head is not used. A boundary-target change (A) therefore acts on the boundary-probability path (M1-style watershed), not directly on M2_hybrid. The M2 distance target is unchanged under A.

gate1_A.definition: t_A = exp(-d^2 / (2 * 0.5^2)) for d <= 1 px, else 0; d = dist.npy (distance to UNIT_BOUNDARY); same UB, same v2 weights, pos_weight 4. Single fixed definition, no sigma sweep.
gate1_A.why_this_one: sigma 0.5 / support 1 px is the narrowest soft target that still marks axial neighbours (t = 0.16 at d = 0.955, p* = 0.43 < 0.5): at the loss optimum exactly the UB pixels exceed 0.5. Chosen from the definition, before any statistic on training sheets.

metrics_per_small_instance.flood_share: share of instance pixels with p* > 0.5
metrics_per_small_instance.interior_cc_max: largest 4-connected component of interior pixels inside the instance
metrics_per_small_instance.theoretical_recovery_M1_rule: frozen M1 post-processing on the p* field (markers = 8-connected CC of p* < 0.3 with area >= 50, watershed on p*); recovered = IoU >= 0.5 with the instance
metrics_per_small_instance.theoretical_recovery_M2_hybrid: official dist.npy + hybrid markers (unchanged by A: identical for v2 and A)

gate1_A.structural_statement: A is still two-sided (UB marks both sides); report the share of instance area that UB itself occupies per width bin

gate2_B.definition: edge_right / edge_down from unit.npy on V = (ignore == 0) & (unit >= 0); a pair is an edge iff both pixels are in V and their units differ (r4b1t_labels.edges_B). No edge against unlabelled or ignored area.

checks.no_duplicate: edge count == number of 4-adjacent valid pairs with different units; ratio of UB pixels to edges reported
checks.keeps_pixels: every valid pixel of every instance is a region pixel under B (no area consumed); reported per width bin
checks.adjacency_complete: set of adjacent instance pairs from instance.npy (4-neighbourhood, valid) == set of instance pairs separated by >= 1 B edge
checks.reconstruction: r4b1t_labels.reconstruct_B on V vs instance.npy restricted to V: partition equality (one-to-one label map); every mismatch listed with cause
checks.topology: count 2x2 checkerboard vertices (diagonal-only contacts of the same unit), single-pixel-wide necks (lt3 instances), instances split by the valid mask
checks.vector_mapping: for the first 2 training sheets in role order (05016, 06054): polygonise the B reconstruction with the stage-C convention (X = col, Y = -row, rasterio.features.shapes, 4-connectivity) and check that the set of unit-length polygon boundary segments between two different regions equals the B segment set (r4b1t_labels.segments_B) exactly

gate2_B.distance_target_B: dist_to_edge (exact distance from pixel centre to the nearest edge segment, clip 32) reported per width bin (max inside instance), and theoretical recovery with hybrid markers on it
gate2_B.label: reconstruction from official labels is a property of the representation, NOT a model result

gate3_reliability.ink: gray black-hat ellipse 9 px > 40 (label-builder definition); ink1 / ink2 = dilated to 1 / 2 px
gate3_reliability.per_sheet_registration: Q3 dx, dy, residual from experiments/R4A/r4a2/dataset_train.json log; and a diagnostic best integer shift of UB within [-2, 2]^2 maximising the share of UB pixels on ink (diagnostic only, never applied to labels)

A.positive_support: share of UB (A-positive) pixels on ink / within 1 px / within 2 px, at shift 0 and at the diagnostic best shift
A.negative_conflict: share of narrow-instance (< 10 px) non-UB pixels within 1 px of ink, shift 0 and best shift

B.positive_support: share of B edges with at least one of its two pixels within 1 px of ink
B.negative_conflict: share of within-instance pixel pairs (non-edges) inside narrow instances with at least one pixel on ink

instance_classes.INK_SUPPORTED: >= 80% of the instance's UB pixels within 2 px of ink
instance_classes.COLOUR_SUPPORTED: Lab dE76 between the instance median colour (pixels not within 1 px of ink; if fewer than 5, pixels not on ink) and the median colour of the dominant neighbouring instance's pixels within 3 px outside the instance (not on ink) >= 10
instance_classes.UNCERTAIN: otherwise; such instances should get no forced narrow-unit supervision
instance_classes.interior_visible: share of instance pixels not within 1 px of ink

gate3_reliability.samples: per width bin 3-6 / 6-10: 6 instances drawn with numpy default_rng(20261029) from the sorted (sheet, instance) list, local panels only

criteria.C1_flooding: theoretical share of 3-6 px instances flooded90 <= 0.30
criteria.C2_recovery: theoretical 3-6 px recovery under the candidate's own post-processing >= 0.50 (A: M1 rule on p*_A; B: direct reconstruction from edges)
criteria.C3_reliability: narrow-unit negative_conflict <= 0.30 at shift 0, and VISUALLY_SUPPORTED share of 3-6 px instances >= 0.50
criteria.C4_topology: A: n/a (pixel labels); B: reconstruction partition-equal for >= 99.9% of instances, all mismatches explained
criteria.C5_m2_distance_head: distance target exists and is unchanged or exactly derivable
criteria.C6_engineering: changes to model head, loss, post-processing, vector export listed with estimated effort
criteria.C7_hardware: fits Apple M4 16 GB (output channels and memory at batch 8, tile 512)

gate4_decision.rule: a candidate is eligible iff C1, C2, C3, C4 hold; if both eligible prefer the smaller engineering change; if none eligible: STOP, no training proposal, report which criterion failed
gate4_decision.sampling_fix: Gate 1 of R4-B1 interior anchor evaluated separately; included only as a marked combination experiment
gate4_decision.output: one minimal falsifiable training plan, not started

gate5_test_sheets.rule: walk experiments/R4A/sheet_draw.json validation_order (seed 20261028, frozen 2026-10-28) from order 6 onward; skip any code already visited in any role (training, validation, development 05030/06061/08004/08001, registration-diagnosis 15061/13068, sealed 08011/08021, and every code in dataset_train.json / dataset_validation.json logs); apply the unchanged Q1/Q2/Q3 rules of experiments/R4A/gtf_dataset.py (download if needed); stop at 2 PASS
gate5_test_sheets.recorded: order, status, download sha256, Q3 numbers, licence status (same as other GSJ sheets: INTERNAL_RESEARCH_APPROVED_BY_PROJECT_OWNER / THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_UNCONFIRMED)
gate5_test_sheets.forbidden: no model inference, no instance or recovery statistics on these sheets before a checkpoint is frozen; labels may be built only after the B1 freeze
